name: Stack Fire Ball

Drop the ball to crash down through the colors, ring after ring, and hold back the moment a black piece rolls underneath you, because touching black ends the run on the spot.
The fun is all in the timing. The tower spins at changing speeds and the ball builds speed on the way down, so each drop is a quick choice between pushing on and waiting a beat. Breaking several rings in a row lifts your score, and every new run is a chance to beat your last one. It is free to play in your browser on a phone or a computer, which makes it a great pick for a short break.

description: Drive luxury supercars across open 3D stunt maps, hit ramps, drift, use nitro, and play solo or with friends.

content.metaDescription: Play Madalin Stunt Cars Pro free in your browser. Drive luxury supercars, use nitro, and try ramps, loops, and open stunt maps solo or with friends.
content.about:
Madalin Stunt Cars Pro is a free 3D driving game built around open stunt play instead of races or lap times. You choose a high-end supercar or a police cruiser, then head into one of three large map areas. Each map gives you room to speed up, drift, and test the car on ramps, loops, highways, and open roads. There is no strict mission to finish. The goal is to pick a car, pick a map, and see what kind of jumps, slides, and near misses you can pull off.
A round is simple: start the engine, build speed, use nitro on long stretches, and aim for stunt spots around the map. The challenge comes from controlling the car after big launches, using the handbrake without spinning out, and finding clean lines through each area. You can play solo, or create a multiplayer room and drive around the same maps with friends. It runs free in the browser with no download or install needed.
highlights: Three open map areas with stunt terrain
Ramps, loops, highways, and wide roads
Solo play or multiplayer rooms with friends
Nitro, handbrake, camera, and reset controls
Police cruiser with police lights
content.goodFor: Madalin Stunt Cars Pro is good for players who like open driving, drifting, and stunt jumps without a timer. It also fits players who want a simple multiplayer room to cruise and experiment with friends.
content.howToPlay: Choose a car and a map, then drive freely through the open area. Use speed, nitro, ramps, loops, and the handbrake to create stunts and control drifts. There is no race to win, so your main goal is to explore and pull off clean jumps and smooth driving lines.
content.touchHint: Use a keyboard for steering, nitro, and reset
tips: Use nitro on long open roads so you have enough speed before ramps and loops.
Tap the handbrake for drifts; holding it too long can make the car slide too far.
Line up straight before big ramps to make landings easier to control.
Use reset if the car gets stuck or lands badly, then try the stunt again from a cleaner angle.

name: Drift Hunters Pro
description: Slide through six 3D tracks, earn cash from clean drifts, and upgrade 10 cars for solo or multiplayer runs.

content.metaDescription: Play Drift Hunters Pro free in your browser. Drift on six 3D tracks, earn in-game cash, upgrade 10 cars, and join multiplayer rooms with no download.
content.about:
Drift Hunters Pro is a free 3D drifting and racing game about keeping your car sideways through corners. You can play alone and chase high scores across six tracks, or enter a multiplayer room and drift on the same server with other drivers. The garage includes 10 vehicles, and each one can be upgraded with the in-game currency you earn from successful drifts. New cars give you another way to attack familiar corners and find a style that fits your driving.
A run is all about control. Steer into a corner, use the handbrake when you need it, and try to hold a smooth slide without overcorrecting or spinning out. The handling is physics-driven, so small inputs matter more than mashing buttons, and clean throttle and steering make a real difference. Earn more, improve your car, test the tuning menu, and try a new track or setup. Drift Hunters Pro plays free in your browser with no download, install, or account needed, on desktop and mobile devices.
highlights: Six tracks for solo high-score drifting
Multiplayer rooms on the same server
10 upgradable vehicles in the garage
Tuning menu for testing different setups
No download, install, or account needed

tips: Use solo runs to learn the six tracks before joining multiplayer rooms.
Tap the handbrake to start a slide, then steer smoothly to keep it going.
If a car feels hard to control, use earned currency on upgrades and test again.
Try different vehicles and tuning setups; each car can change how a track feels.

name: CS Online
description: Join online rooms, pick a map and weapon rules, then fight in first-person team or free-for-all matches.

content.metaDescription: Play CS Online free in your browser, join multiplayer shooter rooms, pick maps like Sanctum, and fight in Free for All or Team Deathmatch.
content.about:
CS Online is a 3D multiplayer first-person shooter played in browser rooms. You create a profile, open the room list, and choose a match by map and mode. Maps include Sanctum, Yarimar, and Sumerra. Rooms can use different weapon rules, such as all weapons, crazy mode, or all no RPG. You can also make your own room, set the maximum number of players, and decide how the match will run before anyone joins.
A match is about moving fast, aiming well, and using the right weapon at the right time. You can play Free for All, where every player is a target, or Team Deathmatch, where your side works together against the other team. Weapons are selected with number keys, so you can swap between options like a knife, pistols, rifles, launchers, and grenades. The action can change quickly as players reload, crouch, run, jump, and chat. CS Online plays free in your web browser with no download needed.
highlights: Online multiplayer rooms with custom match settings
Maps include Sanctum, Yarimar, and Sumerra
Free for All and Team Deathmatch modes
Weapon rules include all weapons and all no RPG
Nine weapon slots selected with number keys
content.goodFor: CS Online is for players who like fast browser shooters with real online rooms. It is a good fit if you enjoy picking a map, choosing match rules, and jumping into quick gunfights.
content.howToPlay: Join an available room or create your own, then choose the map, mode, weapon policy, and player limit if you are hosting. Move around the 3D map, aim with the mouse, and shoot opponents while managing your reloads and weapon switches. In Free for All you fight everyone, while Team Deathmatch is about helping your team win fights.
content.touchHint: Use a mouse and keyboard for full control
tips: Check the room list before joining so you know the map and mode you are entering.
Create your own room if you want control over the map, weapon policy, and player limit.
Reload after a fight when you have cover instead of waiting until your weapon is empty.

name: Escape Car
description: Steer through a mini-city chase, grab cash, drift around danger, and escape police cars, tanks, and helicopters.

content.metaDescription: Play Escape Car free in your browser, steer through a mini-city chase, grab stacks of cash, and dodge fast police cars, tanks, and helicopters.
content.about:
Escape Car is a top-down 3D driving game set in a compact city full of traffic and danger. You control a car with simple left and right steering, then try to stay ahead of the chase for as long as you can. Police cars close in behind you, while tanks and helicopters add more pressure. Along the way, you pick up stacks of cash and build your score with sharp drifts, quick fake-outs, and wrecked police cruisers.
Each round is fast and easy to start, but it gets harder the longer you last. The fun comes from reading the chase, turning at the right moment, and using the city space to make pursuers miss. The two-button controls are simple, yet the timing can be tricky when several threats crowd the screen. Escape Car plays free in your browser with no download, install, or account needed.
highlights: Top-down 3D chase through a mini-city
Dodge police cars, tanks, and helicopters
Collect stacks of cash while you drive
Simple two-button steering
Score with drifts, fake-outs, and crashes
content.goodFor: Escape Car is good for players who like quick driving rounds with simple controls and rising pressure. It fits anyone who enjoys drifting, dodging traffic, and chasing a higher score.
content.howToPlay: Steer left or right through the city, collect cash, and avoid being caught by police cars, tanks, and helicopters. Your score goes up when you pull off tight drifts, trick pursuers, and cause police cruisers to crash. Stay alive as long as possible to earn more score and money.
content.touchHint: Use touch steering to turn left or right
tips: Do not drive straight for too long; quick direction changes help make pursuers miss.
Use tight drifts near corners to turn away from danger without losing your route.
Go for cash when there is space around it, not when police cars are closing in.
Watch for tanks and helicopters early so you do not steer into a trap while escaping cars.

faq.q: Is Escape Car free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Escape Car is free to play in your browser, with no download, install, or account needed.

faq.q: Can I play Escape Car on a phone or computer?
faq.a: Yes. Escape Car is an HTML5 browser game and is listed for mobile play. On a computer, use A or the Left Arrow to steer left and D or the Right Arrow to steer right.

faq.q: What is the goal in Escape Car?
faq.a: The goal is to survive the chase as long as you can. Collect cash, avoid police cars, tanks, and helicopters, and build your score while staying on the road.

faq.q: What are the controls for Escape Car?
faq.a: Use A or the Left Arrow to steer left. Use D or the Right Arrow to steer right.

faq.q: How do you get a higher score in Escape Car?
faq.a: You score by lasting longer, collecting cash, making tight drifts, tricking pursuers, and causing police cruisers to crash.

name: FPS Strike

content.about:
FPS Strike is a free browser shooter built around quick multiplayer battles. You join first-person combat rooms and start fighting without a long setup or a download. Matches take place on five different maps, with two match types: Free-for-All and Team Deathmatch. The weapon list has more than 18 options, including pistols for precise shots and sniper rifles that can take down a target with one strong hit. The action is seen from a first-person view, so aiming, movement, and timing matter in every fight.
A round is fast and direct. Move through the arena, aim carefully, fire, reload, and change weapons when the fight shifts. You can jump over danger, crouch behind cover, check the scoreboard, pause, and open the weapon shop during play. Free-for-All pushes you to watch every direction, while Team Deathmatch gives you a side to fight with. The challenge comes from reacting quickly while choosing the right weapon for the distance and the situation. FPS Strike plays free in the browser with no download required.
highlights: Free-for-All and Team Deathmatch modes
Five unique multiplayer maps
18+ weapons, from pistols to sniper rifles
Browser play with no download required
Scoreboard, crouch, reload, and weapon shop controls
content.goodFor: FPS Strike is good for players who want short, direct multiplayer shooter matches. It fits players who like arena combat, fast aiming, and switching weapons during a fight.

content.touchHint: Use keyboard to move and mouse to aim and shoot
tips: Use the right mouse button before firing at distant targets, especially with sniper rifles.
Switch weapons with number keys or the mouse wheel when a reload would take too long.
Reload after a fight so you do not run out of ammo in the next duel.
Learn the five maps so you can expect where close fights and long shots happen.

faq.q: Is FPS Strike free to play?
